fields.label: Company Abbreviation
fields.description: Used as a short prefix for your invoice numbers. Auto-filled from your company name — edit if you'd like something different.

fields.label: Chart of Accounts
fields.description: A template for how your income and expenses get categorized. We've picked one for your country — you usually don't need to change this.

fields.label: Financial Year Begins On
fields.description: When your financial year starts. Most businesses use the default for their country — change this only if your accountant asks you to.

installationTypes.title: Advanced Installation
installationTypes.description: Skip the walkthrough and configure everything yourself in the full admin panel.
